title: A unified quantitative approach to Chiti and Kohler--Jobin inequalities
summary: We obtain two quantitative results related to classical rearrangement inequalities for the first Dirichlet eigenvalue. The first one is a quantitative version of Chiti's reverse Hölder inequality. More precisely, for every $1\le q<p<\infty$, we prove that the deficit controls, up to translations, the $L^q$ distance between a first eigenfunction of a bounded domain and the first eigenfunction of the ball having the same first eigenvalue.
